messages:
Maria: Heads-up — provisioner in eu-west-1 is stuck after the VPC ejection-policy rollout. Nodes are marked for ejection but not terminating; audit logs to central bucket delayed ~10m. GPUs idle, autoscaler hitting backpressure.
Aj: seeing same. kube-provisioner logs spamming 'eject failed: audit-logger timeout'.
Sam: paste from provisioner:```
2026-03-20T08:12:34Z provisioner ejection controller: attempt=7 err="PutObject timeout to s3://redwood-audit-eu (403?)"
```
Aj: 403 to S3 -> KMS/role issue probably. We rotated keystore earlier?
Olga: we did a keystore rotation and tightened role boundary in the morning window, could have lost the audit-writer grant.
Kevin: CloudTrail shows PutObjectDenied for role arn:aws:iam::222222222:role/audit-writer around 08:11 UTC.
sre-oncall: paging oncall. Keystore rotation might have replaced key policy, blocking cross-account grants until we re-add them.
deploy-bot: Deployment 4721 completed: `vpc-eject-policy/v2` at 2026-03-20T08:10:05Z
Maria: timeline matches. Eject policy deploy 08:10, keystore rotation ~08:11 — bad overlap.
Aj: mitigation options: 1) revert eject policy 2) create temporary KMS grant for audit-writer 3) relax S3 bucket policy to allow current role.
Sam: we need a quick unstick to avoid warmup backlog — GPUs reserved but not usable, cost impact ramping.
Olga: creating incident INC-312 and attaching playbook link https://confluence.redwood/vpc-eject-playbook
Sam: quick test — can someone try an S3 put from a node role?
```bash
aws s3api put-object --bucket redwood-audit-eu --key test.txt --body /dev/null --profile node-role
```
Kevin: tried from node-178: AccessDenied, failed on kms:Encrypt against alias/redwood-eu-keystore.
sre-oncall: short-term workaround: add the node-role to the key policy with Encrypt/Decrypt or create a one-off grant. Alternatively disable encryption requirement for the bucket temporarily (less preferred).
Maria: I can push a rollback of the eject-policy flag now if we agree.
Aj: please rollback. Also open an autoscaler bypass so new nodes can register even if audit-logger is degraded (mark audit as best-effort during warmup).
Olga: rolling back eject-policy flag now (08:18 UTC).
deploy-bot: Rollback 4722 executed: `vpc-eject-policy/v2` revert at 2026-03-20T08:18:12Z
Sam: nodes are coming back, warmup proceeding. We had ~120 pending pods; after bypass we're down to ~30.
Kevin: creating security ticket to add persistent KMS grant for audit-writer and document the grant in config-as-code.
Olga: adding a cost callout — rough estimate ~300 GPU-hours if this stayed >3h. Looping in finance.
Maria: will own a short postmortem and propose a pre-deploy checklist: verify KMS grants + S3 bucket policy before any VPC-level ejection rollout.
sre-oncall: add console alert for audit-logger PutObject latency/403 rate so we catch this before autoscaler chokes.
Aj: noted and will add a runbook step for deploy windows to avoid keystore rotations during eject policy changes. :thumbsup:
